_help: One letter per friend. title = short heading, text = the memory (use \n for a new paragraph), photo = a file you put in public/assets/photos/, written as assets/photos/<file>.jpg, or "" for no photo. Optional, written on the back of the photo (she taps the polaroid to flip it): photoDate = when it was taken (e.g. "12 Mar 2024"), photoLocation = where (a location id like "canteen", or any short text), photoCaption = a short handwritten caption. finale.text is the group message shown at the end.

jathin.title: [PLACEHOLDER] A memory from Jathin
jathin.text:
[PLACEHOLDER: Jathin writes their real letter here.]

Happy birthday! This is where a favourite memory of her goes: the day, the place on campus, what made it special.

It can be as long as you like; the letter scrolls.
